scenes.description: ممر رخامي مظلم وفاضي، وستارة حرير ثقيلة تتمايل ببطء بدون أي ريح، كأن أحد مرّ من عندها قبل لحظة. الكاميرا تتقدم بهدوء نحوها.

shot.lens: 35mm anamorphic, f/2.8, deep focus with subtle oval flares
shot.lighting: Low-key chiaroscuro. Hard warm 2800K amber shaft from a tall window far camera-right grazing the silk, cool 6500K teal ambient fill at very low level, deep shadows on the marble walls, faint specular sheen on the polished floor
shot.composition: Vertical 9:16 frame with the heavy silk curtain placed at the center-right third and tall marble columns leading lines up the frame. Large negative space of dark ceiling above and reflective floor below. No people in frame.
shot.subject_action: The heavy silk curtain sways slowly from side to side as if someone just walked past it.
shot.setting: Empty dark marble corridor in a luxurious private residence, polished floor, tall columns, heavy silk drapery
shot.color_notes: Warm amber highlights against deep teal shadows, no readable text or signage anywhere

scenes.description: لقطة قريبة للهب شمعة يميل باتجاه واحد بهدوء، وخلفه ينعكس ضوء الكريستال المنكسر على الجدار ويرتجف ارتجافة خفيفة. المكان يحس بوجوده.

shot.lens: 75mm anamorphic, f/2.0, shallow depth of field with creamy oval bokeh
shot.lighting: Practical candle flame as warm 1900K key, hard amber rim on the wax edge, cool 6000K teal bounce from the dark wall behind, refracted crystal light fragments as soft bokeh sparkles, deep black shadows
shot.composition: Vertical 9:16 frame with the flame in the upper-center third, tall dark negative space above and the candle body below, background wall filled with out-of-focus golden light fragments.
shot.subject_action: The candle flame bends steadily in one direction as if a presence passed by.
shot.setting: Dark marble hall, a single candle on a stone surface with a crystal chandelier glow refracting on the wall behind
shot.color_notes: Amber flame against teal darkness, glints of gold in the bokeh

scenes.description: كتف شاب بإضاءة جانبية يعبر الإطار ببطء ويختفي في العتمة، ويبقى خلفه غبار ذهبي معلّق في الهواء.

shot.lens: 50mm anamorphic, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, soft falloff
shot.lighting: Hard warm 3000K side key from camera-left carving the edge of a dark tailored jacket shoulder, 5600K backlight lighting floating dust, cool teal ambient fill very low, subject fades into black shadow on the right
shot.composition: Vertical 9:16 frame with the shoulder and jaw edge entering at the left and leaving at the right, face kept turned away and mostly in shadow, large dark negative space on the right where he vanishes, dust visible in the backlit area.
shot.subject_action: A young man in a dark tailored jacket walks across the frame in profile and exits into the darkness.
shot.setting: Same dark marble corridor, a pool of window light on the floor, dark columns in the background
shot.color_notes: Golden dust particles over deep teal shadows, rich black of the jacket with a subtle fabric sheen

scenes.description: لقطة قريبة للزجاجة الفاخرة على طاولة من حجر داكن وحولها بخار خفيف، والكاميرا تقترب منها بهدوء وتثبت عليها.

shot.lens: 100mm macro, f/2.8, shallow depth of field with the background melting into dark bokeh
shot.lighting: Soft 3200K amber key from camera-left creating a long highlight along the glass edge, crisp 5600K rim light behind to outline the cap and shoulders, cool teal fill from the right, dark polished stone reflecting a faint mirror image, light mist catching the backlight
shot.composition: Vertical 9:16 frame with the bottle centered in the upper two thirds of the frame, the lower fifth left as clean dark stone for the tagline and end card, bottle has a plain unmarked glass surface with no legible text or logo.
shot.subject_action: The camera pushes in very slowly on the bottle while a thin wisp of mist drifts across the stone surface.
shot.setting: Dark stone tabletop in the marble room, soft mist, a faint glow of golden dust in the background
shot.color_notes: Warm amber glass highlights, deep teal shadows, glints of gold, no readable text
